description: fischer cavity dowel DuoHM 6 x 55 S PZThe DuoHM cavity dowel covers all standard building material thicknesses from 9.5 - 30 mm with just one length. Thanks to the unique combination of nylon and metal, the DuoHM allows high loads and maximum flexibility in panel building materials. The metal sleeve folds behind the building material and presses against the back of the plate, the plastic dowel spreads in the plate. The DuoHM is quick and easy to assemble using a cordless screwdriver without additional setting tools. This reduces assembly time up to 50% compared to conventional panel anchors. Thanks to the metric internal thread, the attachment part can be screwed in and loosened several times. In addition to the included screw, the DuoHM can also be used with other metric screws. The anti-rotation nylon protection protects the surface of the building material from damage. Due to the narrow dowel edge, the dowel is no longer visible behind the attachment.
